theme: 3 terms on JSON in Swift: the protocol that makes a type convertible, the class that reads JSON, and the enum that renames keys

terms.definition: A protocol pair that lets a type turn into data like JSON and back again.
terms.example: Make `User` Codable, and we can save it as JSON.

terms.definition: A Foundation class that turns JSON data into a Swift value of the type you name.
terms.example: The JSONDecoder failed because the server sent a number, not a string.

terms.definition: An enum inside a Codable type that maps each property to a different key name in the data.
terms.example: Add CodingKeys so `name` reads the `user_name` key.

video.title: Codable, JSONDecoder & CodingKeys | Day 42
video.description:
Learn to explain JSON in Swift: Codable, JSONDecoder & CodingKeys, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Codable - A protocol pair that lets a type turn into data like JSON and back again.
JSONDecoder - A Foundation class that turns JSON data into a Swift value of the type you name.
CodingKeys - An enum inside a Codable type that maps each property to a different key name in the data.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: Swift Codable, JSONDecoder & CodingKeys | Day 42
landscape.description:
Explain Codable, JSONDecoder & CodingKeys in Swift by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
Codable, JSONDecoder, CodingKeys 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Codable - A protocol pair that lets a type turn into data like JSON and back again.
한국어: Codable: 타입을 JSON 같은 데이터로 바꾸고 다시 되돌릴 수 있게 해 주는 프로토콜 묶음

JSONDecoder - A Foundation class that turns JSON data into a Swift value of the type you name.
한국어: JSONDecoder: JSON 데이터를 지정한 Swift 타입의 값으로 바꿔 주는 Foundation 클래스

CodingKeys - An enum inside a Codable type that maps each property to a different key name in the data.
한국어: CodingKeys: Codable 타입 안에서 각 프로퍼티를 데이터의 다른 키 이름과 연결하는 enum

In this video, Mina and Jake sort out why decoding failed, how to keep Swift names when the server uses other keys and what makes a type convertible, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.
Mina와 Jake의 채팅 스타일 대화와 화면 속 Swift 코드로 배워요.

landscape.hook: Can you explain JSON decoding in English?

dialogue.title: Why did decoding fail?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, the JSONDecoder throws an error when I decode `Profile`.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What key does the server send for `userName`?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's it. The JSONDecoder looks for `userName` and can't find it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, keep the Swift name. Add CodingKeys and map `userName` to `user_name`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do I need CodingKeys for every property?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Once you add CodingKeys, list every property you want in the JSON.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. Codable gives you decoding and encoding for free.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Got it. Codable on the type, CodingKeys for names, JSONDecoder to read it.
Make it Codable, and it turns into JSON.
